title: 10、要用火（修）
content_zh:
林小笑就是给庆尘制造梦魔的人。
这个世界也从来都不是只有机械文明，它延续至今，一直都还有更加神秘的文明存在。
而今晚，林小笑制造这个梦魔，完全是听了李叔同老板的指令，想要试试庆尘到底是个什么样的人。
当下这个名叫“双鬼困境”的梦魔，林小笑想用来试一下庆尘是个什么样的人。
结果这少年的反应，有点不是人。
此时此刻的庆尘没有丝毫颤抖，也没有普通人奋起反抗时的血勇之色，身上所凝聚的只有二字，冷静。
可是林小笑想不明白，他明明在阻止对方拿起匕首来着，为何对方突然脱离了梦魔的束缚。
要知道，这里可是他林小笑的主场啊。
这时，庆尘已经知道自己不用去楼上杀人了，他对着空旷的客厅说道：“林小笑？”
梦魔未散，林小笑穿着警察制服从楼上笑眯眯的走了下来：“奇了怪了，你在这梦魔里竟然还能保持清醒。”
“为什么这么做？我好像并没有冒犯到你，”庆尘不解。
“我这可不是欺负你，而是考察你。不过现在看来，梦魔可能对你没什么作用了，”林小笑坐在楼梯的最后一阶解释道。
“这是你的特殊能力？”庆尘问道。
“是的，”林小笑耸了耸肩膀：“就像是你有过目不忘一样，我也有我的能力，这倒没什么好隐瞒的。”
庆尘一时间觉得，这个世界在他的脑海中越发神秘起来。
他这时反而放松了下来。
对方在这监狱里手眼通天，自己与之相比就像是个刚学会走路的小孩子一样。
既然如此，那也就不用太紧张了。
“你们要招揽我？”庆尘问道。
此刻林小笑赫然发现，对方在面对这未知的梦魔、未知的自己时，竟已完全放松下来，游刃有余。

这少年才17岁。
林小笑好奇道：“你为什么来18号监狱？”
庆尘心里在想，我要说我也不知道自己进来干什么，你肯定是不信的……
这事……你得问路广义啊……
说实话，庆尘这会儿也暗自思忖，自己是不是该找路广义弄清楚前因后果？
只不过想到路广义那话唠加舔狗的模样，他又有点头疼。
“不想说也没关系，我迟早会弄明白的，”林小笑说道：“行了，早点休息吧，明天早上你还得陪老板下棋呢。”
话音刚落，庆尘眼睛一黑便脱离了梦魔，他从牢房地板上缓缓爬起，躺在冰冷的床上不知道想着什么。
他看着那扇厚重的合金闸门，门外是冰冷又神秘的世界。

清晨，李叔同如往常那样坐在餐桌旁，静静的看着一副残局。
此时还没到囚犯们出监舍的时间，整个监狱都静悄悄的。
林小笑蹲在椅子上说道：“老板，我昨天晚上用双鬼困境试探他来着，您猜怎么着，他直接就要提刀先杀一个……这杀性也太重了吧。”
叶晚皱眉：“说了让你适可而止的，普通人进双鬼困境很容易崩溃的。”
“放心，”林小笑没好气道：“我压根就没进行下去，而且你不知道，那小子竟然能在梦魔里脱离我的掌控。”
“哦？”李叔同抬起头来：“我确认他还只是个普通人而已，一个普通人能在梦魔里脱离你的掌控，这倒有点特殊了。”
这下，就连桌上闭目养神的大猫都奇怪的看了林小笑一眼。
叶晚问道：“他是怎么做到的？”
“不清楚，”林小笑摇头。

“可能是自身意志足够强大吧，”李叔同没有深究此事，能够挣脱梦魔束缚的，也不止庆尘一人。
林小笑蹲着说道：“老板，我还是劝你慎重考虑一下吧，庆尘这小子杀性很重，跟我们不是一路人。”
“杀性？”李叔同忽然笑了起来：“我们为了这份事业死了那么多同僚，连你我三人都被困在这座监狱里。所以你要明白啊小笑，我们不能用温柔去应对黑暗，要用火。”
说着，李叔同的神色竟是有些暗然了：“叶晚，把口琴给我拿过来。”
快要开饭了，监狱里渐渐喧哗起来，钢铁野兽们在合金闸门里吵闹的声响，犹如热锅里的开水渐渐沸腾。
可是监狱的广场上面忽然响起悠扬的口琴声，沁人心脾。
囚犯们拍打牢房门的声音渐渐停歇了，所有人都静静的听着，像是有人用清泉淋入了干涸的荒原。
content_en:
Lin Xiaoxiao was the one who created the nightmare for Qingchen.
This world has never been just about mechanical civilization. It continues to this day, and there are always more mysterious civilizations.
And tonight, Lin Xiaoxiao created this dream monster just because he listened to the instructions of his boss Li Shutong and wanted to test what kind of person Qingchen was.
Lin Xiaoxiao wanted to use this nightmare called "Double Ghost Dilemma" to test what kind of person Qingchen was.
As a result, this young man's reaction was a bit inhuman.
At this moment, Qingchen didn't tremble at all, nor did he show the bloody courage that ordinary people have when they rise up to resist. There was only two words condensed on his body, calmness.
But Lin Xiaoxiao couldn't understand why the other party suddenly broke away from the shackles of the dream demon when he was clearly trying to prevent him from picking up the dagger.
You know, this is Lin Xiaoxiao’s home court.
At this time, Qingchen already knew that he didn't have to go upstairs to kill anyone. He said to the empty living room: "Lin Xiaoxiao?"
Before the nightmare was gone, Lin Xiaoxiao came down from upstairs wearing a police uniform and smiled: "It's strange, you can still stay awake in this nightmare."
"Why do you do this? I don't seem to have offended you," Qingchen was puzzled.
"I'm not bullying you, I'm just testing you. But now it seems that the Dream Demon may have no effect on you," Lin Xiaoxiao explained while sitting on the last step of the stairs.
"Is this your special ability?" Qingchen asked.
"Yes," Lin Xiaoxiao shrugged: "Just like you have a photographic memory, I also have my abilities. There is nothing to hide."
Qingchen felt for a moment that the world was becoming more and more mysterious in his mind.
Instead, he relaxed now.
The other party's hands and eyes are all in this prison, and compared with him, he is like a child who has just learned to walk.
In this case, there is no need to be too nervous.
"You want to recruit me?" Qingchen asked.
At this moment, Lin Xiaoxiao suddenly discovered that the other party was completely relaxed and at ease when facing this unknown dream demon and the unknown self.
This boy is only 17 years old.
Lin Xiaoxiao asked curiously: "Why did you come to Prison No. 18?"
Qingchen was thinking, if I say that I don’t know what I came in for, you won’t believe me...
You have to ask Lu Guangyi about this...
To be honest, Qingchen was also thinking secretly at this moment, should he find a way to find out the cause and effect?
But thinking about Lu Guangyi's talkative and licking attitude gave him a headache.
"It doesn't matter if you don't want to say it. I will figure it out sooner or later," Lin Xiaoxiao said, "Okay, go to bed early. You have to play chess with the boss tomorrow morning."
As soon as he finished speaking, Qingchen's eyes darkened and he broke away from the dream demon. He slowly climbed up from the cell floor and lay on the cold bed without knowing what he was thinking.
He looked at the heavy alloy gate. Outside was a cold and mysterious world.

Return countdown 20:59:20.
In the early morning, Uncle Li sat at the dining table as usual, quietly watching the mess.
It was not yet time for the prisoners to leave the cell, and the entire prison was silent.
Lin Xiaoxiao squatted on the chair and said: "Boss, I tested him with the double ghost dilemma last night. Guess what, he immediately picked up the knife and killed one first... This is too murderous."
Ye Wan frowned: "I told you to stop. Ordinary people will easily collapse when they are in the dilemma of two ghosts."
"Don't worry," Lin Xiaoxiao said angrily: "I didn't proceed at all, and you don't know that that kid was able to escape my control in the dream demon."
"Oh?" Li Shutong raised his head: "I confirm that he is just an ordinary person. It is a bit special that an ordinary person can escape your control in the dream demon."
At this time, even the big cat on the table with his eyes closed looked at Lin Xiao strangely.Smile.
Ye Wan asked: "How did he do it?"
"I don't know," Lin Xiaoxiao shook his head.
"Maybe it's because his will is strong enough," Li Shutong did not delve into the matter. Qingchen was not the only one who could break free from the shackles of the dream demon.
Lin Xiaoxiao squatted and said, "Boss, I'd better advise you to think about it carefully. Qingchen is a very murderous kid and he's not from the same group as us."
"Murderous?" Li Shutong suddenly laughed: "We have killed so many colleagues for this cause, and even you and I are trapped in this prison. So you have to understand, Xiaoxiao, we can't deal with the darkness with gentleness, we have to use fire."
As he said that, Li Shutong's expression turned a bit sad: "Ye Wan, bring me the harmonica."
It was almost time for dinner, and the prison gradually became noisy. The noise of the steel beasts in the alloy gate was like boiling water in a hot pot.
But the melodious harmonica sound suddenly sounded in the prison square, which was refreshing.
The sound of the prisoners banging on the cell door gradually stopped, and everyone listened quietly, as if someone had poured a clear spring into the dry wasteland.
